in_sanskrit.name: Vinnu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, New
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vinnu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vinnu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vin' which means new and 'Nu' which means little. This name signifies the arrival of a new and little being into the world.

in_marathi.long_meaning: Vinnu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vinnu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vin' which means new and 'Nu' which means little. This name signifies the arrival of a new and little being into the world.
